classification.difficultyReason: Select addition versus hollow subtraction for three supplied component solids, infer the central cylinder length by removing cone height and hemisphere radius, then combine familiar volume formulas. No proof or unsupplied optimisation.

content.prompt: Calculate the volume of each solid. Where appropriate, give your answers correct to two decimal places.

spec.description: Cylinder with a hemispherical hollow descending from its complete top rim, diameter dimension above and cylinder height beside it. Rear bottom boundary is dashed.
spec.mathematics: Cylinder diameter 8 cm and height 10 cm; removed hemisphere radius 4 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only given dimensions and the top centre point are visible.

sizing.exceptionReason: Reviewed narrow/tall source solid: retain proportional geometry, all dimensions and native 10 pt labels. Height above the ordinary 40 mm review trigger may be necessary for distinguishable marks; working space is unchanged.

answer.short:
$368.61\text{ cm}^3$.

Subtract the hemispherical hollow from the cylinder.
answer.worked:
The radius is $8\div2=4\text{ cm}$. Subtract the hemisphere from the cylinder.
$$\begin{align*}V&=\pi r^2h-\frac12\times\frac43\pi r^3\\V&=\pi\times4^2\times10-\frac23\pi\times4^3\\V&=160\pi-\frac{128\pi}{3}\\V&=\frac{352\pi}{3}\\V&\approx368.61\text{ cm}^3\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Hemisphere above a downward cone, sharing a circular join with solid front and dashed rear arcs. The vertical dimension runs only from the join to the cone apex.
spec.mathematics: Common diameter 10 cm; cone perpendicular height 12 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only given dimensions and the common-base centre point are visible.

answer.short:
$575.96\text{ cm}^3$.

Add the hemisphere and cone volumes.
answer.worked:
The common radius is $10\div2=5\text{ cm}$. The cone height is $12\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}V&=\frac12\times\frac43\pi r^3+\frac13\pi r^2h\\V&=\frac23\pi\times5^3+\frac13\pi\times5^2\times12\\V&=\frac{250\pi}{3}+100\pi\\V&=\frac{550\pi}{3}\\V&\approx575.96\text{ cm}^3\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Horizontal cone, cylinder and hemisphere in that order, with circular joins, centre points, overall length above, cone length below and common diameter at right.
spec.mathematics: Overall axial length 16 cm, cone height 5 cm, common diameter 6 cm. Cylinder length must be inferred.
spec.answerVisibility: No inferred radius or cylinder length is printed.

answer.short:
$329.87\text{ cm}^3$.

The cylinder is $16-5-3=8\text{ cm}$ long; add all three component volumes.
answer.worked:
The common radius is $6\div2=3\text{ cm}$. The hemisphere extends $3\text{ cm}$ along the axis.
$$\begin{align*}h_{\text{cylinder}}&=16-5-3\\h_{\text{cylinder}}&=8\text{ cm}\\V&=\frac13\pi r^2h_{\text{cone}}+\pi r^2h_{\text{cylinder}}+\frac23\pi r^3\\V&=\frac13\pi\times3^2\times5+\pi\times3^2\times8+\frac23\pi\times3^3\\V&=15\pi+72\pi+18\pi\\V&=105\pi\\V&\approx329.87\text{ cm}^3\end{align*}$$
